nativeAdaptations: React effect and memo lifetimes are explicit preparation-pass, cancellation, cache, and displayed-layout ownership.
Ratatui paint polls a result channel and never executes third-party layout work while holding the renderer.
Native subprocesses receive immutable source snapshots; provider reads remain lazy and are performed only for sides bound by the accepted declarative layout.
Refresh state uses the same view-wide plus file-scoped epoch sum already ported in workdeck-extension-host.
